title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to f8267df93aba, past the spec deletion of checkPageComponentViewData
body:
Fixes #23908
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `daeb77fc84dd` to `f8267df93aba`, objectui `main` at `f8267df93aba8fb09cc1cc0692eadc0c8c5a5e56`. That commit carries `15d8ca6da` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12678, card objectstack-ai/objectui#12666), which drops objectui's import of `checkPageComponentViewData`. #23784 (`a35f7a6764`) deleted that export from the spec. With the new pin, `pnpm objectui:build` on `main` builds again.

It also carries one Spec Shape Gate registry entry for #23846 (`adad73f714`, `SelectOptionSchema.kind`) against objectstack-ai/objectui#12711. The claim declared this extra.

The deprecated re-export is **not** restored. `packages/spec/src/**` is untouched, and the deletion stands.

**Tier:** not governed. `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-23908-console-pin-past-23784`: 0 of 6 paths hit the register. Size: 6 files, +113 / −12.

## Choosing the pin

- The candidates are objectui `main` commits at or after `15d8ca6da`. When this was read, there were two: `15d8ca6da` and `f8267df93` (the tip; objectstack-ai/objectui#12679, card objectui#12486). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 15d8ca6da… origin/main` exits 0. The objectui clone is not shallow.
- The tip was chosen because it is the latest candidate, and it builds against this tree's spec (readings below). No fallback was needed.

## Gate (a): Console Pin Gate, local equivalent

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --filter=@objectstack/spec`. 34/34 tasks passed.
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin, with `OBJECTUI_ROOT` pointing at a blobless objectui clone, under the verify lock. It ended with `VERDICT command-exit 0`:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal, `{major:4,minor:6,patch:7}`, across 2253 `assets/*.js`;
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it";
   - "dist ready (64708 KB) from objectui@f8267df93aba".
3. `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` reads `f8267df93aba8fb09cc1cc0692eadc0c8c5a5e56`. `pnpm check:console-sha` reads "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@f8267df93aba)". `pnpm check:console-injection` reads "the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one". Both exited 0.

The `[MISSING_EXPORT] "checkPageComponentViewData"` from the card does not appear: the console build passed `vite build`.

## The second half: manifest and lockstep record

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` read `.cache/objectui-f8267df93aba/apps/console` and wrote 107 components (sha256 `beba7d3fe260…`). It also re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin.
- `sdui.manifest.json` moves in two places, both from objectui changes in the range:
  - `page:header` no longer publishes the `showStar` input. This comes from objectui `608033b82` (card objectui#12627), which follows the spec's retirement of the key (#23650).
  - `page:header.maxVisible`'s description gains two sentences, about the host's own buttons and the primary button (objectui `ef71a09f9`).
  - No component is added or removed. The accept set only narrows, so `Clause-②: no` holds.
- `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-f8267df93aba pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-recorded `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at the pin. The grammar blob `0131f27cf86d` and the predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` are unchanged, and `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes). No parser port is owed.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0. With `OBJECTUI_ROOT` set and `--require-objectui`, it also confirms that `@object-ui 17.7.0` is the version the pin declares.
- `packages/console/dist/` is not tracked. Nothing in it was edited by hand.

## Gate (b): Spec Shape Gate, local equivalent

The steps are the workflow's own:

- `npm pack` of this tree's built spec;
- a separate objectui worktree at `main` = `f8267df93aba`, with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`;
- `spec-shape-gate.mjs inject`;
- `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check --continue`, which ran 81 turbo tasks (78 passed, 3 failed: `@object-ui/react#build`, `@object-ui/react#type-check`, `@object-ui/types#type-check`);
- `spec-shape-gate.mjs report`, which exited **0**: "5 diagnostic(s), all registered retirements -- known, not red."

| objectui file | line | code | reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts` | 130, 138, 150, 157 | TS2344 | known (registered: objectstack-ai/objectui#12711), **this PR's entry** |
| `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` | 1945 (x2: build and type-check) | TS2345 | known (registered: objectstack-ai/objectui#12654), seat 1's F4 entry |

- `layout.zod.ts:25` (TS2305) is gone, and so is `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts:145`: `grep -c 'layout.zod\|checkPageComponentViewData'` over the log reads 0. The `types` package's `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.examples.json` passed, and its chained `tsconfig.test.json` produced only the four rows above.
- **The blind spot, closed.** `@object-ui/react`'s chained `tsconfig.test.json` never runs under `type-check`, because its first `tsc` is red on the F4 row. It was run on its own (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit` in `packages/react`). It reports exactly two rows, `SchemaRenderer.tsx:1945` TS2345 and `SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx:171` TS2322. Both are covered by seat 1's existing F4 entry.
- **No other red row.** Nothing needed `git log -S` attribution, and nothing belongs to another seat.

## The registry entry

`scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` gains one entry: `objectstack_pr` 23846, `objectstack_commit` `adad73f71483abf84b470e90367fe8080c44a4e0`, `downstream_card` `objectstack-ai/objectui#12711`, `registered_at` 2026-10-16.

- It has one pattern: `file` `packages/types/src/__tests__/select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts`, `code` `TS2344`, `message` `Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'.` (the full first line). The pattern carries no line number, so it covers all four rows.
- `retired` says what happened. Nothing was retired: the spec ADDED an optional key, and objectui's convergence pins red on a new key by design. The entry is deleted when objectui#12711 closes.
- **Where the measurement comes from.** Seat 1 measured it first (`6215839271` on #18549: objectui `f78efdd1e3` against objectstack `570f01d270`, the same four lines). This PR re-measured it against objectui `f8267df93aba` and this branch's spec, in the table above.
- `parseRegistry` accepts the real file (2 entries). `pnpm check:spec-shape-gate` (the self-test) passes 60/60. This PR edits the registry, so the workflow's `pull_request` trigger runs the real gate here.

## objectui commits `daeb77fc..f8267df9` that touch the spec consumption surface

The range has 40 non-merge commits. The 14 below change a line naming `@objectstack/spec` (`git show` excluding Markdown):

- `15d8ca6da` fix(types): drop the page view-data check objectstack main deleted (objectui#12666). **This is why the pin moves.** Without it the console does not build against this tree.
- `f8267df93` objectui#12486: the page renderer drops its `kind: 'jsx'` arm. The spec already refuses `jsx` at parse. Breaking for `PageNodeSchema.kind`, answered in the changeset's ADR-0087 note.
- `f62b6ff4e` deps(v18): objectui resolves `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.2`. No effect on the console build, which injects this tree's spec through `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`. The single-zod canary passes.
- `608033b82` `page:header` stops reading `showStar`. This is the manifest's one input removal, above.
- `a98a23c78` Studio retires the two delegated-admin switches the spec retired (#23488's objectui half).
- `3eb3ec138` objectui#12504: `DataSource.updateViewConfig` and its capability gate are retired. Breaking for `@object-ui/types`; nothing in this tree calls it.
- `023087f63` `resolveRecordPointer` reads `referenceDeletedWhen`.
- `c6a42be39` objectui deletes its copy of the spec shape gate. The gate now runs only here.
- Imports or type references only: `f78efdd1e`, `db8ce2f41`, `8614705c1`, `ef71a09f9`, `33fbc861d`, `7b5e55893`.

None of these blocks the pin: the console builds and the shape compile reads only registered rows.

## The console changeset

`.changeset/console-f8267df93aba.md` was written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit f8267df93aba…`, following `docs/releases-maintenance.md` step 3.

- `@objectstack/console` **minor**: 46 releasing changesets across 40 non-merge commits, 3 annotated breaking, 3 commits without a changeset.
- The script's ADR-0087 placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Each of the three breaking entries is answered against this tree.
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` all exit 0.
- Because the pin's changeset is a real declaring changeset, `skip-changeset` is not applied.
- **File-surface note:** the claim allowed a `.changeset/23908-*.md` only if a gate asked for one. The pin's own changeset is named `console-SHA12.md` by the bump script, as on every earlier hop. No other changeset is added.

## Verification, at `0136ab25c`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, merge base `161aee104`) derived 71 commands. Each was run, with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` with exit codes reads "71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero)".
- Two commands first exited 3 (prerequisite not met). Both were re-run green at the same head:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its fixture commit `621a48760` was outside the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a48760…` it passed 48 cases.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it needed a full build. `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs` passed 75/75, and the gate then read 110 entries across 68 packages.
- This PR changes no package source, so no package `test` / `typecheck` is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- #23885 remains open: it is the hourly full-battery card, and it goes with the next green run, not with this PR.
- objectui#12711 remains open. Its registry entry here is deleted when it closes.
